summary: Verified DB-only admin storage audit, recent-exports panel, and per-book file-health pre-flight. New backend test file test_audit_recent_health.py (8 tests) passes alongside the existing test_admin_storage_audit.py (8) and test_upload_validation.py (5) — 21/21 green for the targeted iteration-14 surface. Broad pytest run: 179 passed, 12 pre-existing failures (all in test_assets_api.py / test_books_api.py / test_assets_book_scope_iter10.py / test_pdf_export.py where hand-crafted PNG_BYTES fail strict Pillow validation — flagged as known in the request). Frontend UI: login, More dropdown, Storage Audit dialog, and Recent Exports dialog all work end-to-end against the public preview URL.

issues: Dialog copy says 'Cross-pod visibility' instead of literal 'scope: cluster-wide' as the spec requested. The underlying API does return scope:'cluster-wide' so this is purely a UX-copy preference, not a bug.

action_items: Optional: surface the literal phrase 'cluster-wide' (or 'cluster-wide visibility') in RecentExportsDialog so admins recognise the spec wording.

Pre-existing: 12 backend tests use hand-crafted PNG bytes that fail Pillow validation (test_assets_api.py, test_books_api.py, test_assets_book_scope_iter10.py, test_pdf_export.py::test_pdf_export_embeds_image_blocks). Rewrite them to use Pillow-generated PNGs when bandwidth allows. NOT new — explicitly called out by main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 1742-1830: admin_storage_audit uses 2 indexed Mongo queries (db.books + db.files) with projections — O(n) memory but no I/O. Safe, fast, no S3 fetches. ✓
server.py 1833-1857: admin_recent_exports projects only display fields, ISO-stringifies datetimes — no _id leak. ✓

server.py 1860-1917: file-health pre-flight queries db.files with $in for unique paths only (deduped). Auth check before book lookup uses request.state.user_id which is set by the existing /api/* middleware. ✓

Editor.jsx 1203-1228: pre-flight calls /file-health and aborts setExporting(true) when body.problems.length > 0; uses options.__skipHealthCheck flag to avoid looping when user clicks 'Export anyway'. Good defensive code (silent fall-through on network/HTTP failure so the pre-flight is advisory not blocking). ✓
StorageAuditDialog.jsx and RecentExportsDialog.jsx read token from localStorage.getItem('bindery_token') — consistent with the rest of the app. ✓

Live storage audit on prod DB returned 341 file_records / 10 paths referenced — 44 needs_reupload (legacy uploads pre-iter-54) and several orphaned paths flagged. The audit is doing exactly what's advertised.
